EmailTemplate.subject: This June, Support Sickle Cell Patients in the Summer Heat!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi <Name>
The American Red Cross relies on our dedicated partners like you to fulfill our mission of helping patients battling sickle cell disease receive the most compatible blood.
One in three African American blood donors are a match for people with sickle cell disease.
The success of your previous blood drives enables us to help these patients tremendously. During the summer months when blood donations tend to drop, sickle cell patients are still relying on blood donors to donate blood.
June offers a special time of recognition, with Dr. Charles R. Drew’s birthday on June 3 and World Sickle Cell Awareness Day and Juneteenth on June 19. It’s the perfect time to highlight Black communities coming together — and what better way to celebrate community than by hosting a blood drive to support those in the community battling ailments such as sickle cell disease?
Please consider hosting a Red Cross blood drive this summer. Let’s find time to talk. Would <Day of Week> of this week work, or would next week be better?
Sincerely, <AM/SAM/ABM Name>
